lines.speaker: L#IGB11
lines.text: "The lone adventurer, left and betrayed by his own group, was wading through layers of slime and sewage. All of his former friends thought he was dead, but he has always been a stubborn one, and he still had a few aces up his sleeve. He survived. But the sewers weren't a safe place, or at least not these tunnels. Lately, they were taken over by strange worm-like creatures. They already knew he was there, and they were preparing for an attack."

lines.speaker: JANJ
lines.text: Ah, that sounds like something that happened to one of my cousins, and—perhaps she should actually write her story down. Perhaps it could become a recognized piece of writing, just like some of those books around us. Mmm, I believe I should tell her that, or maybe even offer some help.

lines.speaker: L#IGSTA
lines.text: This one is a one-on-one fight for survival. The fee for learning from most of those books is 3,500 gold pieces, but using this one costs only 3,000 gold pieces.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Fine. It's only fair for the original leader, <PLAYER1>, to face these creatures.

lines.speaker: L#IGSTA
lines.text: Right! Well, I hope you picked the right person to go through this test.

lines.speaker: L#IGB2
lines.text: "The archon was called back to her deity, to Kwan Ying. On one hand, she understood Chin Yi's anger, as well as her grief. On the other hand, her archon's fury saddened her. In the end, Kwan Ying gave new shape to her trusted celestial: she let her rage become the scream of the Celestial Fury, a powerful sword, born from her beloved one's sword."

lines.speaker: L#IGB1
lines.text: Who shall learn from this tale? Who shall embrace the fury? Or shall you rather focus on the heavenly peace that was rejected once the storm came?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I chose to see this as a story of wrath and revenge. I can understand where all that anger came from.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I chose to see this as a story of heavenly love, so electric, and a rejection of peace that felt more like ignorance.

lines.speaker: L#IGB2
lines.text: And who shall learn from it? Who shall know the wrath?

lines.speaker: L#IGB5
lines.text: "The devils fell. It must have been the one they were sent to kill; sent by another devil for... whatever reason. What's important is that their target is dead. Now, the heroes shall hope that the devil will grant them the knowledge they needed."

lines.speaker: L#IGB5
lines.text: Who shall be given that book's gift?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The lore shall be the prize. And it should be ours too, by proxy.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I never really cared about the deal. I was there to test myself. And while that devil has not surprised me much, those women and their bows: avoiding them was quite a task.

lines.speaker: L#IGB5
lines.text: Of course. But who shall be the very person to learn it?

lines.speaker: L#IGB9
lines.text: "The rotting orb was levitating in the center of a damp cave. A zombie beholder, who was believed to be dead for a century, or mayhap more. Undead and wild, at the very same time. When it saw any living creature, it would bite them with its powerful maw. This is a dead magic area, so it was used to fighting the unfortunate with its sharp teeth."

lines.speaker: ANOMENJ
lines.text: A zombie beholder? And most likely an angered one. It deserves to be destroyed, and that is exactly what we should do to it.

lines.speaker: L#IGSTA
lines.text: This one can only be faced in a one-on-one battle. That is why the fee for this one isn't 3,500 gold pieces, but slightly lower: 3,000 coins, and you may face it. The same person will learn from that book.

lines.speaker: PLAYER

lines.speaker: L#IGSTA
lines.text: Of course! So, let's start the process.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: You come. We can finally look each other in the eye, my vessel.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What are you?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Oh great. Another monster. Perhaps we should skip the pleasantries and move right on to the unavoidable fight?

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: It is most entertaining that you say this. It truly is proof that we are but one thing.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: I am your blood. I am every drop of this red tincture that's running through your veins; I am what keeps you alive, and bound with who you truly are, <CHARNAME>. I suppose that makes me... you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not sure I understand.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What sort of trick is this?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I suppose that makes sense. I should have expected that the Bloody Pages of Bhaal would be somehow connected to me.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: It's simple: the book you just touched has connected to your blood. To me. That is what allows us to speak the way we do right now.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: It does make sense, doesn't it? The book has connected to your blood, allowing us to speak the way we do right now.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: There are times when an obstacle needs to be thrown a couple of floors down.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is this? Is this the roof of the Iron Throne headquarters?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I do know that, and I am not going to hesitate when someone needs to be pushed and taught how to fly.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am not going to be like Sarevok!

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Yes. So you remember how we climbed up this tower. Perhaps you also remember how it felt to stand here, look at everything and everyone. Those people were so small. Like ants.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I never thought that way about them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Yes. That's more or less what I thought when I was here.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't think I ever reached the roof. But I must have been on the floor just below us.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Are you sure? Why wouldn't we have that thought?

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: I know. We are the same.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: But you must have at least imagined how it would feel to stand here.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Good. I'm glad to hear that.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Aren't we already like your brother?

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: The book you just touched is your story. And we are the ink. I am the ink.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Our story is written in blood, <CHARNAME>, and no matter what you do, it's always going to be that way. No matter if you are the first to raise your blade, you will be the last one to hold it.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Aren't you happy because of it?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Of course I am.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I just want to be left alone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm doing this because I am given no other choice!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm living the life I was given and... I just got used to it.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: You should learn how to enjoy it more. How to be proud of who we are.

lines.speaker: L#IGCS6
lines.text: Yes. Yes, I can feel that pride. It's in me, too.

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E1
lines.text: Thou hast come here. Thou hast come for the judgement of the Moon Sisters! We are the COSMOS that fills this place.

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E2
lines.text: We are the DREAMS that give hope to the scared ones.

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E3
lines.text: And finally, we are the LOVE that can cut even through the darkest nights!

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E1
lines.text: Thou hast come here for a reason, but—strange. Thou art not the soul we have expected. Nay. Thou art something else.

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E2
lines.text: Thou art the Bloodied Child.

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E3
lines.text: Thou art marked with bloody tears; with fear. With chaos. Why do we see a different soul? One that shall have a different face?!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It is strange. It's almost as if you saw the true me, and not the character from this book.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: This is but nonsense. I am not going to listen to this!

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E1
lines.text: Silence! None of this be right!

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E1
lines.text: But we are still the Moon Sisters, and we can see through the COSMOS. Thine path is marked with blood. That be enough for us to know that thine hand must be stopped.

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E1
lines.text: Sisters! Take thine weapons!

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E2
lines.text: For the DREAMS!

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E3
lines.text: For all the LOVE!

lines.speaker: L#IGB8E1
lines.text: And against those that bring nothing but death!
